phases.summary: Ternary ISA, assembler, VM widths, integer formats, native ops, and numeric workloads have regression coverage.

SSA IR is the sole target-code source; global optimization, graph coloring/coalescing, iterative spills, ABI v2 compatibility, opt-in ABI v3 aggregate sret, runtime wrappers, linking, and TCL assembly have focused and quantitative coverage.
Native kernel, VFS, persistent root image, checkpoint-durable namespace/quota policy, process lifecycle, waits, and app handoff are implemented with production tests.
Host SDL runner boots release images, routes input, decodes framebuffer snapshots, and exports text and PNG diagnostics.
Host tools, manifests, debugging docs, diagnostic bundle contracts, Obsidian vault validation, and Graphify-backed knowledge graph tooling now exist for recursive agent loops.
Use deterministic Doom-class interactive and BitNet-style inference workloads as OS capability and performance baselines before importing full external assets.
open_items: Materialize the validated Freedoom WAD payloads and connect a reviewed renderer
Materialize validated BitNet sliced/full model shards when storage policy permits
Archive controlled-host timing baselines before enforcing tighter workload regressions

phases.summary: ASCII, UTF-8, and hexadecimal remain compatibility encodings; fixed TASCII-81, exact trits, and compact base-27/base-81 notation are implemented for host tools and both assemblers.
open_items: Add conversion APIs in the guest app SDK
Teach image and memory dump tools to print ternary-native notation alongside host hexadecimal
